# Daniil Makeev — Senior AI / LLM Engineer

> Senior AI / LLM engineer, 5 years in software. Production LLM systems: agents, RAG, evals and the resilience layer around non-deterministic AI providers. Led a video generation pipeline to 6× faster output at 60% lower cost.

**Canonical URL**: https://wyddy.tech/

## Summary

- Role: Senior Applied AI Engineer / Tech Lead at hao.vc, a Product AI lab (Jan 2025 – present).
- Career: EPAM Systems → Zenit-Electro → hao.vc.
- Location: Yerevan, Armenia (UTC+4). Available immediately. Remote contract (B2B) across EU and US time zones, or relocation. EAEU work authorization. English B2.
- Stack: Python (FastAPI, asyncio, Pydantic v2), PostgreSQL / pgvector, TypeScript; LangGraph, LangGraph.js, DeepAgents; models through OpenRouter (Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek).
- CV (PDF): https://wyddy.tech/makeev-daniil-cv-en.pdf

## Experience

- **hao.vc** — Senior Applied AI Engineer / Tech Lead · Jan 2025 – present. Product AI lab running several products in parallel. Architected the end-to-end multimodal video pipeline: latency 6× (~60 → ~10 min), cost −60% ($2.00 → $0.80 per video), 800K+ organic views. Resilience layer around non-deterministic providers with 200+ automated tests. B2B EdTech interview-scheduling Telegram Mini App on FastAPI and PostgreSQL, used by ~700 students.
- **Zenit-Electro** — Backend / Applied AI Engineer · Jun 2023 – Dec 2024. Python / SQL ETL pipelines saving ~8–12 manual hours a week; prototype of a local LLM assistant for internal search (RAG, structured outputs).
- **EPAM Systems** — Software Engineer (Backend) · Oct 2021 – Jun 2023. Intern / Junior Python Engineer → Middle Backend Engineer. High-concurrency REST microservices on FastAPI, PostgreSQL and asyncio.
- **BMSTU** — BSc Computer Engineering / Computer Systems.

## Selected Work

### hao.vc — Video Generation Pipeline

- Topic to published video: script, voice, images, compose, upload. Production code is under NDA.
- Results: **6× faster** (~60 → ~10 min), **−60%** cost ($2.00 → $0.80 per video), 800K+ organic views.
- Stack: Python, Prefect, OpenAI API, ElevenLabs, Google Imagen, FFmpeg, S3 (boto3), Pydantic v2.
- Case study: https://wyddy.tech/case-video-pipeline.html

### Browd — Browser AI Agent (open-source R&D)

- A browser agent in the Chrome side panel: LangGraph.js plan-and-execute, human approval before risky actions, its own isolated tab.
- 218 tests · 6 failure classes · 52–89% prompt-cache hit rate, measured.
- Live on the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/browd-ai-browser-agent/kgjeibjpgopjomghegdpelbnjgmddobb
- Source (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/wyddy7/browd

### NetWho — Contact RAG in Telegram (open-source R&D)

- Contact RAG in Telegram: pgvector embeddings plus keyword match, answers grounded in source records, isolation per tenant.
- Public demo: https://t.me/netwho_bot
- Source: https://github.com/wyddy7/netwho

### Digest — Personalized AI Digest

- A deterministic pipeline writes the daily digest; a separate stateful chat agent (DeepAgents, LangGraph) answers follow-ups with compacted memory.
- Live, running daily.
- Source: https://github.com/wyddy7/claude-digest
